name: Lady of Dreamless Land
descriptionTemplate: Xu gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: The first time each type of Xu's Command Cards triggers the {Resonance} effect per turn, its Base Arithmetica Cost becomes 0.
lore:
Why tempt them? They were already powerless to resist.
Why incite them? She won't stop until the swirling vortex of power and desire—ever higher, ever wider—swallows everything within sight.
It is because the marrow of a commoner, trapped only by "Love," is quite impossible to swallow. Because a mundane corpse, unmarinated by "Ambition," is utterly tasteless.
The Dreamless Land is but a scrap of a reward, tossed from the predator to the prey.
At the heart of that Rapture lies nothing—only endless Chaos, an infinite and bizarre phantasmagoria.
